description.value:
Teleport up to 100 feet to a space you can see or have seen. You do not need line of effect, only knowledge of the destination. Your arrival does not trigger reactions.

You may bring up to four willing adjacent creatures with you, placing them in spaces adjacent to your arrival.

  • 5th: range 250 feet.
  • 10th: range 500 feet. You no longer need knowledge of your destination; you may specify a direction and distance instead. As you pass through, you perceive the destination. If it cannot hold you, the GM tells you before you commit, and you may redirect or abort without spending the action.
  • 15th: range one mile. You may bring one adjacent creature against its will. It attempts a Will save against your Class DC or Spell DC, whichever is higher. On a failure it is teleported with you and is Off-Guard until the end of your next turn.

The range is 100 feet at 1st, 250 at 5th, 500 at 10th and one mile at 15th.
